speaker: Sheldon
text: Uh-oh. I was going to get my mail.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, damn, they canceled my visa. Oh, yay, a new MasterCard. What?

speaker: Penny
text: Okay.

text: Are you hoping to get it telepathically?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I think you mean telekinetically. And no. I just wasn't sure of the proper protocol now that you and Leonard are no longer having coitus.

speaker: Penny
text: God, can we please just say no longer seeing each other?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, we could if it were true. But as you live in the same building, you see each other all the time. A variable which has changed since the coitus.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, here's the protocol. You and I are still friends, and you stop saying coitus.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Good. I'm glad we're still friends. Oh, yes. There was a lot of work to accommodate you in my life. I'd hate for that effort to have been in vain. Just to be clear. Do I have to stop saying coitus with everyone, or just you?

speaker: Penny
text: Really?

speaker: Penny
text: Right.

text: Everyone.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Harsh terms, but alright, I'll just substitute intercourse. Or fornication. But that has judgmental overtones, so I'll hold that in reserve.

speaker: Penny
text: Great.

speaker: Penny
text: So, how you been?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, my existence is a continuum, so I've been what I am at each point in the implied time period.

speaker: Penny
text: You're just coitus-ing with me, aren't you?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Bazinga.

speaker: Penny
text: How's Leonard doing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: He seems alright, although he does spend a disturbing amount of time looking at photographs of you and smelling the pillow you slept on. Although now that I think of it, he asked me not to tell you this.

speaker: Penny
text: I'll pretend I didn't hear it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Rather you pretend I didn't say it. I see you bought Mama Italiano marinara spaghetti sauce.

speaker: Penny
text: Yep.

speaker: Sheldon
text: That's the sauce my mother uses. She likes cooking Italian because according to her, that's what the Romans made Jesus eat.

text: Interesting. I'll have to have you over for spaghetti some night.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm hungry now.

text: Oh, um, okay. Why don't you give me an hour and come over?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Will you cut up hot dogs into little chunks and mix them in with the sauce?

speaker: Penny
text: I don't have hot dogs.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's alright, I do. You're in for what my mother calls a real Italian treat. I was talking with Penny.

speaker: Leonard
text: Hey, where you been? What's wrong with you? You can't hang out with your roommate's ex. It's fine. I don't care. I'm over it.

text: Yeah, he's over it. That's where he's been whining all day about trying to invent that memory wiper he bought from Men in Black. Is he making any progress? Because I'd like to erase Ben Affleck's hair better.
